cardEffects:
[Breeding] [Your Turn] All of your Digimon can't digivolve.
[Breeding] [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a [Royal Knight] trait Digimon card would be played, you may reduce the play cost by 4. Further reduce it by 1 for each of this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[Breeding] [Start of Your Main Phase] Reveal the top card of your Digi-Egg deck, then place that card and all of your [Royal Knight] trait Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards.
inheritedEffect: [Breeding] [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an Option card with the [Royal Knight] trait is placed in the battle area, gain 1 memory.

rulings.answer: This effect additionally increases the numerical value of the play cost reduction in "when a [Royal Knight] trait Digimon card would be played, you may reduce the play cost by 4" in this carad's 2nd [Breeding] [Your Turn] effect.  For example, if this Digimon has 1 digivolution card, the numerical value of the play cost reduction will be 5.
rulings.question: What does "further reduce it by 1 for each of this Digimon's digivolution cards" in this card's 2nd [Breeding] [Your Turn] effect mean, exactly?

rulings.answer: No, you must perform as much of the processing as possible.
rulings.question: Can I choose to not reveal the top card of my Digi-Egg deck and not place my [Royal Knight] trait Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards for this card's [Breeding] [Start of Your Main Phase]?

rulings.answer: The player that activated the effect chooses the order of the bottom digivolution cards that are placed.  Note that the cards placed by this effect must be placed under any already placed digivolution cards.
rulings.question: If multiple cards are placed as the bottom digivolution cards for this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect, what order are the cards placed?

rulings.answer:
No, it isn't processed.  
Overflow is processed when a card is sent from the area or from under a card to another area.  In this case, 
Overflow isn't processed because a card from the area is placed under another card.
rulings.question: When I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to place a BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] under this card as a digivolution card, is BT17-078 [Omnimon ACE] processed?

rulings.answer: No, they can't be reduced. [BT8-071 Psychemon]'s effect does not target Digimon, so even if your opponent's [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] is in the breeding area, its effect to reduce play costs can't be activated.
rulings.question: Can the play cost of a Digimon with the [Royal Knight] trait be reduced due to the [Your Turn] effect of my opponent's [BT13-007 King Drasil_7D6] if [BT8-071 Psychemon] is in play?

rulings.answer: No, using and activating [BT10-110 Seiken Meppa]'s [Main] effect does not cause a card to be "placed" in the Battle Area, so this card's inherited effect does not trigger.
